what_could_break.item: Amount board totals change when only page number changes
what_could_break.reason: PDT-3453 defect: totals were computed from current page rows; fix must keep totals stable across page 0..N for the same filters

what_could_break.item: Totals ignore liabilities/receivables on later pages
what_could_break.reason: Customer feedback requires sum of all amounts of all pages when no filters selected

what_could_break.item: Filter checkbox changes do not update Amount board
what_could_break.reason: Ticket expected: totals change only when selecting different checkboxes / filter+search, not on bare pagination

what_could_break.item: Receivable sign / liability-receivable netting on board
what_could_break.reason: Confluence: receivables contribute as negative; board can show negative or zero when receivables exceed liabilities

confluence_evidence.title: Customer Receivable/Liability
confluence_evidence.source: REST fallback (Atlassian MCP searchScope jira-only; asterbit Confluence cloudId not granted to MCP). Page fetched via get-confluence-page-rest.ps1.
key_findings: Tab after Invoice; default 25 rows/page; pagination required
Default list: latest not-covered liabilities/receivables (current amount > 0), deposits excluded unless shown
Amount board Initial/Current: dynamic based on filtering or search; equal sum of amounts of liabilities/receivables/deposits shown further down; can be negative
Doc does NOT explicitly state all-pages aggregation vs current-page-only (gap called out in PDT-3453 comment by Ani Giorganashvili)

jira.summary: Customer -> Receivables and Liabilities - The customer balance is changing when switching the pages
jira.description_formatted: Actual: TOTAL Current Amount and TOTAL Initial Amount change when switching pages. Expected: should not change when switching pages; should change only when selecting different checkboxes.
jira.customer_feedback: TOTAL Current Amount and TOTAL Initial Amount must show sum of all amounts of all pages together, not only the page on screen, when no filters selected.
jira.clarification_reason: needs clarification for total amounts / pagination logic

findings_for_generator.title: Amount board pagination totals not specified on Confluence
findings_for_generator.spec_says: Confluence Amount board: amounts update based on filtering/search and equal sum of items 'shown further down' (ambiguous for multi-page lists).
findings_for_generator.ticket_says: PDT-3453: totals must not change on page switch; must equal sum across all pages when no filters; change only when checkboxes/filters change.
findings_for_generator.recommendation: Update Confluence Amount board section with explicit all-pages aggregation rule; TCs validate ticket + customer-feedback expected behavior.
